scope: Preliminary PCOS marginal-limit Cartesian-box stress test; not a simultaneous posterior interval, no claimed 95% coverage, no inferred joint draws.
interpretation: Corners may not be jointly plausible. A zero-crossing box establishes scenario sensitivity only; it does not show non-significance or a posterior probability. A net-change box crossing zero can make an unconstrained percentage box unstable or unbounded, so no percentage interval is calculated.
